segment.source: So what's going on? Why are you holed up in here?<end>
segment.target: So what's going on? Why are you holed up in here?<end>

segment.source: Those pompous gits, the Oligarchs, think they can cut me off from what's happening. I came here to stand against the Faceless and yet they told me, in no uncertain terms, to pack up and leave.<end>
segment.target: Those pompous gits, the Oligarchs, think they can cut me off from what's happening. I came here to stand against the Faceless and yet they told me, in no uncertain terms, to pack up and leave.<end>

segment.source: "None of your business," they said. Since when is Core City none of my business? I dominated these streets back when they were still nothing but Biocorp henchmen.<end>
segment.target: "None of your business," they said. Since when is Core City none of my business? I dominated these streets back when they were still nothing but Biocorp henchmen.<end>

segment.source: I bet the Protectorate has something to do with this. They are trying to get established here, I can smell it! Well, if they think I'm just going to sit on my hands and let the Cans run around the Underrail, they've got another thing coming.<end>

segment.target: We're gonna get a foothold in this city no matter what. That's why I rounded up these boys and girls here. $(context.player.Name). Meet the Zone Rats and their leader Sneaky.<end>

segment.source: <end>

segment.source:
Back in the old days, Dan and I were inseparable. We did almost everything together: We robbed together, killed together and spent our free time together. And oh boy, we were a deadly team. And you can tell just by how many times the two of us came out of combat as the only survivors. So, there were these bandits that called themselves The Black Crawlers. Yup, those we smashed.
They used to be our main rivals in Core City. It's bloody true.<end>
segment.target:

They used to be our main rivals in Core City. It's bloody true.<end>

segment.source: One time, during one of the skirmishes, we killed their leader's son. Actually, I killed him; it was one of those situations where me and that lazy bum were the only survivors. But, what followed next surprised us more that it should have: In a few days, the Crawlers found our camp in Core City and tried to take us out. I don't know how they managed to find us, but it seemed like the whole gang was there, and they were thirsty for blood.<end>

I don't know how they managed to find us, but it seemed like the whole gang was there, and they were thirsty for blood.<end>

segment.source:
This used to be that camp. You know that by now.
It was a well fortified position, but were basically in a dead end. We exchanged fire with them for a while, and then they stormed our position. They were shot at, burned, electrocuted, even bloody blown to pieces, with limbs flying all over the place, but they just kept coming and eventually overran our defensive positions.<end>

segment.source: So, Dan and me got holed up in the back of the camp, in a small building. Small, but sturdy. The lazy bum was manning a machine gun while I was gunning them down with my assault rifle, yelling. Funny enough, we had fun - until a grenade flew in through the window and we had to split. I jumped out one window, Dan jumped out the other one. I moved behind some cover and, bam, there he was.<end>

segment.source: Who was there?<end>
segment.target: Who was there?<end>

segment.source:
The leader of The Black Crawlers - Helaku. He was a boulder - bastard with a huge scar on his nose who, unlike his weak minions, could really mess a man up. I was staring down his bloody crossbow, and he knew I killed his son and wanted to send a bolt through my eye. But Dan came to the rescue: One well placed shot from his gun shattered Helaku's wrist and made him drop the crossbow.
I don't know why Dan didn't go for the head, that derailed bugger, but I reacted fast and grabbed the falling crossbow mid-air, turned it around and sent one bolt right in his forehead. His eyes rolled backwards, his jaw dropped, and he fell dead.<end>

As for the Black Crawlers, eventually they settled here. But, what do you know, we kicked them out. Wimps!<end>

segment.target: I spent quite a number of years in Core City before I came to SGS, so I know where to look and who to ask when I need something. And I needed a local, capable, low profile group for our operations.<end>

segment.source: Thus, Zone Rats.<end>
segment.target: Thus, Zone Rats.<end>

segment.source: How do these consoles work again...?<end>
segment.target: How do these consoles work again...?<end>

segment.source: ::He frowns.:: Pay attention this time.<end>
segment.target: ::He frowns.:: Pay attention this time.<end>

segment.source: What can you tell me about the Omega station?<end>
segment.target: What can you tell me about the Omega station?<end>

segment.source: They used be our neighboring station. Now they're mostly dead. Those who aren't, they are scattered throughout Underrail.<end>
segment.target: They used be our neighboring station. Now they're mostly dead. Those who aren't, they are scattered throughout Underrail.<end>

segment.source: What happened?<end>
segment.target: What happened?<end>

segment.source: A bloody war happened, that's what. Our relations shattered into pieces and we fought each other until one side got eradicated.<end>
segment.target: A bloody war happened, that's what. Our relations shattered into pieces and we fought each other until one side got eradicated.<end>

segment.source: Were you involved?<end>
segment.target: Were you involved?<end>

segment.source: Yes.<end>
segment.target: Yes.<end>

segment.source: Can you tell me how it started?<end>
segment.target: Can you tell me how it started?<end>

segment.source: No. Listen, it's complicated, the whole thing, and I'm not interested in explaining it to you.<end>
segment.target: No. Listen, it's complicated, the whole thing, and I'm not interested in explaining it to you.<end>

segment.source: You find someone else for that.<end>
segment.target: You find someone else for that.<end>

segment.source: How about I ask you something else?<end>
segment.target: How about I ask you something else?<end>

segment.source: If you must.<end>
segment.target: If you must.<end>

segment.source: Nothing.<end>
segment.target: Nothing.<end>

segment.source: Actually...<end>
segment.target: Actually...<end>

segment.source: Now...<end>
segment.target: Now...<end>

segment.source: Good. You're here. There's work to be done.<end>
segment.target: Good. You're here. There's work to be done.<end>

segment.source: You backtalk me like that again, you runt, and I'll punch your ugly head off and feed it to the rathounds.<end>
segment.target: You backtalk me like that again, you runt, and I'll punch your ugly head off and feed it to the rathounds.<end>

segment.source: What do you want?<end>
segment.target: What do you want?<end>

segment.source: Listen, $(context.player.Name), don't you start thinking you're some kind of tough $(#guy/girl) after flicking a couple of switches in some bloody old outposts. Just to let you know.<end>
segment.target: Listen, $(context.player.Name), don't you start thinking you're some kind of tough $(#guy/girl) after flicking a couple of switches in some bloody old outposts. Just to let you know.<end>

segment.source: Yeah?<end>
segment.target: Yeah?<end>

segment.source:
Listen, $(context.player.Name), and listen good: There's already enough crap going on right now without you dumping a big steaming pile in the corner when no one's looking. Yeah, the witnesses may have testified in your favor, but you cause trouble one more time and you're getting the boot, you got that?
The boot!<end>
segment.target:
Listen, $(context.player.Name), and listen good: There's already enough crap going on right now without you dumping a big steaming pile in the corner when no one's looking. Yeah, the witnesses may have testified in your favor, but you cause trouble one more time and you're getting the boot, you got that?
The boot!<end>

segment.source: ::He continues after a brief pause.:: Now what do you want?<end>
segment.target: ::He continues after a brief pause.:: Now what do you want?<end>

segment.source: ::The tall, imposing figure of this battle-scarred veteran towers before you. You met Gorsky before. He is one of the councilors that interviewed you when you first arrived.::<end>
segment.target: ::The tall, imposing figure of this battle-scarred veteran towers before you. You met Gorsky before. He is one of the councilors that interviewed you when you first arrived.::<end>

segment.source: So you passed all of Tanner's little tests and exercises. That could not have been easy, but don't think you're some kind of a hotshot now. You are yet to deserve the privilege you've been given.<end>
segment.target: So you passed all of Tanner's little tests and exercises. That could not have been easy, but don't think you're some kind of a hotshot now. You are yet to deserve the privilege you've been given.<end>

segment.source: I'm looking forward to the opportunity.<end>
segment.target: I'm looking forward to the opportunity.<end>

segment.source:
We'll see.
So why are you here?<end>
segment.target:
We'll see.
So why are you here?<end>

segment.source: I understand.<end>
segment.target: I understand.<end>

segment.source: ::He nods.:: So why are you here?<end>
segment.target: ::He nods.:: So why are you here?<end>

segment.source: Yeah, whatever, pops.<end>
segment.target: Yeah, whatever, pops.<end>
